tool.description: Advanced card database with instant HD image retrieval and real-time price tracking. Provides comprehensive card data including all versions, rarities, and market values in a single API call. Optimized for gaming professionals with AI-powered image enhancement and automatic format conversion.

card_data.name: Sky Striker Ace - Zero
card_data.effect:
3 Link Monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Sky Striker" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Sky Striker Ace - Zero". You can only use this effect of "Sky Striker Ace - Zero" once per turn. When a card or effect is activated that targets a "Sky Striker" card you control (except during the Damage Step): You can negate that effect.
